izzy: IzzyBlazor apps, blocks and pages from IzzyBlazor's catalog.

Usage:
  izzy list [starter|kit|block|component] [--json]
  izzy describe starter|kit|block <id> [--json]
  izzy describe component <Name> [--json]
  izzy describe component --all --json
  izzy describe crud|init [--json]
  izzy add block <id> [--<setting> <value> ...] [--at <file>:<line>] [--project <path>] [--dry-run] [--diff] [--json] [--overwrite]
  izzy add component <Name> [--example <name> | --tag] --at <file>:<line>[:<col>] [--stdin] [--project <path>] [--dry-run] [--diff] [--json]
  izzy inspect <file>:<line>:<col> [--stdin] [--project <path>] --json
  izzy set <file>:<line>:<col> --<option> <value> ... [--unset <option>] [--stdin] [--project <path>] [--dry-run] [--diff] [--json]
  izzy add crud <Model> [--name <Plural>] [--singular <words>] [--plural <words>] [--route <path>] [--mode Grid|Pages] [--store Ef|Memory] [--context <DbContext>] [--authorize] [--project <path>] [--dry-run] [--diff] [--json] [--overwrite]
  izzy new starter|kit <id> [-n <name>] [-o <folder>] [--<setting> <value> ...] [--dry-run] [--diff] [--json] [--overwrite]
  izzy init [--preset <preset>] [--brand <color>] [--interactivity None|Server] [--keep-css] [--mcp] [--project <path>] [--no-build] [--dry-run] [--diff] [--json] [--overwrite]
  izzy audit <url> [--sizes 1440,375] [--schemes light,dark] [--cookie <name=value>] [--out <folder>] [--format md,json,tasks] [--fail-on any|real|new] [--baseline <results.json>] [--browser <path>] [--json]
  izzy audit --site <url> [--max-pages 500], or izzy audit --urls <file>
  izzy audit [<path> ...] --run [--site] [--project <path>]
  izzy agent [--project <path>] [--dry-run]
  izzy mcp
  izzy login [--no-browser]
  izzy logout
  izzy account [--json]
  izzy feedback ["<what happened>"] [--about "<command>"] [--yes] [--json]

result.stdout:
Starters (7), each described by izzy describe starter <id>:
  blazor         Microsoft's Blazor Web App with IzzyBlazor's components and theme, in every render mode, with the same options.
  docs           A documentation site: a sidebar of sections, an article column, the article's headings beside it, and previous and next links. (free account)
  inbox          An app that fills the window: a sidebar of views, a list, and the chosen item beside it. On phones the list and the item are two screens. (free account)
  rail           An app shell with a full-height sidebar that collapses to an icon rail, the brand at its top and the account at its foot. (free account)
  sidebar        An app shell with a header and a sidebar that becomes a drawer on phones. (free account)
  site           A website shell with links in the header, a centered page column and a footer, and no sidebar. (free account)
  topnav         An app shell with its links across the header, folding into a menu on phones, and a centered page column. (free account)

Kits (1), each described by izzy describe kit <id>:
  crm            A whole CRM, every page static: contacts, companies, a deal pipeline, activities and reports, with a team, roles, an audit log and sample data. (free account)

Blocks (15), each described by izzy describe block <id>:
  access-denied  Where people land without the role a page needs: which role, who can give it, and a way to switch accounts. (free account)
  articles       The latest posts as cards: a cover, the category, the title, a short excerpt, and who wrote it and when. (free account)
  contact        Three ways to reach you beside a short form: checked on the server, answered with a toast, guarded by a honeypot. (free account)
  cookies        Ask before any cookie that isn't essential: a notice until the visitor chooses, a settings page, and a way for your code to check. (free account)
  empty-state    What a list shows when it's empty: the one action that fills it, or a way to clear the search. (free account)
  faq
[truncated]
